g.text: GP-UCB waveform validity for the dynamic plasma circuit

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68737d

g.text: The wafer waveform is fitted; upper reflection is excluded from optimization and retained as a circuit-level validation output.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Representative seed 0 is the median fitted run, not the best run. Wafer nRMSE=9.365e-05; held-out reflection nRMSE=3.340e-03.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Known synthetic target and identical circuit equations are used; this validates the bounded inverse workflow, not an experimental plasma model.
